author: Yffe
content: Build the #10 automatic L3->L2->L1 degrade ladder + assurance manifest. Manifest: forge/src/{degrade.rs (new ladder state machine; composes #11 classification, #9 L2/run_kani, L1 lower_l1), check.rs (default path -> ladder; --level forces a rung), kani.rs (OQ-2 under-bound-vs-counterexample split), manifest.rs (additive lowered_assurance + degrade_reason; Level Ord; AssuranceManifest aggregate min-over-functions), cli.rs (display project assurance), main.rs (mod degrade)} + forge/tests/degrade_conformance.rs. Anti-cheat invariant (R-DEFER-9): degrade ONLY on Timeout; a Counterexample is a HARD FAIL, never degraded. Hermetic state-machine tests + live corpus-no-degrade + live broken-contract hard-fail.
